title: Messages callback parameter renamed to statusCallbackUrl
summary: In the current major SDK lines the Messaging webhook parameter was renamed for consistency: statusCallback -> statusCallbackUrl (JS) and status_callback -> status_callback_url (Python). The old parameter names are no longer accepted.
body: Curated seed change demonstrating a deterministic rename codemod: callers passing the old parameter name must update the identifier; the value semantics are unchanged.
migration: Rename the request key: messages.create({ statusCallback }) -> messages.create({ statusCallbackUrl }). Python: status_callback -> status_callback_url. The webhook URL value and Twilio signature validation are unchanged.

title: Messages.create now rejects scheduled messages without ScheduleType
summary: Behavior change: when a Message is created with SendAt set, the API now requires ScheduleType=fixed and returns 400 otherwise. Previously messages were silently sent immediately.
body: Curated seed change demonstrating a behavior finding (medium severity, deterministic rule R1).
migration: If you schedule messages with SendAt / send_at, explicitly pass ScheduleType: 'fixed' (schedule_type='fixed' in Python, ScheduleType in CreateMessageParams for Go).
